title: 28/04/2026 The inauguration of SIDBI’s new Branch Office in Raipur by the DMD,SIDBI marks a significant step in strengthening the Bank’s presence in Chhattisgarh and enhancing support to the MSME sect
description: 28/04/2026 The inauguration of SIDBI’s new Branch Office in Raipur by the DMD,SIDBI marks a significant step in strengthening the Bank’s presence in Chhattisgarh and enhancing support to the MSME sector in the region. The office, located at LIC Building, Pandri, will improve accessibility and service delivery for MSMEs across the state. The occasion also saw participation from senior officials, industry representatives, customers, and key stakeholders, reflecting strong engagement with the ecosy
